purpose: Define workload concurrency classes, queueing and scheduling priority explicitly while preventing priority metadata from bypassing dependency, authorization, transaction or consistency rules.

topics.name: DWH Concurrency and Priority
topics.purpose: Define workload concurrency classes, queueing and scheduling priority explicitly while preventing priority metadata from bypassing dependency, authorization, transaction or consistency rules.

semantics.concurrency_rule: Maximum concurrent executions are explicit per workload/profile/resource scope.
semantics.priority_rule: Scheduling priority/class is explicit and bounded.
semantics.fairness_rule: Starvation/fairness handling is explicit where relevant.
semantics.dependency_rule: Priority cannot violate transaction, migration, schema or causality dependencies.
semantics.consistency_rule: Scheduling optimization cannot weaken requested consistency profile.
semantics.order_rule: Arrival time alone does not define semantic precedence.
semantics.preemption_rule: Preemption, if supported, follows the explicit cancellation/preemption profile.

invariants.rule: Admission, quotas, concurrency, priority, cancellation and resource budgets may control when/how work executes but never change canonical query/write semantics, data ownership, classification or authorization.

hard_gates.condition: arrival order treated as business priority
